events.title: A Benevolent Intervention
events.body: A soft, melodious chime sounds through your apartment array. The Steward has detected elevated biometric stress and offers 'guided equilibrium.'

choices.text: Accept the neuro-calm session. Let the AI soothe your pulse.

success.text: Warm light fills the room. Your heart rate slows, but a quiet piece of your ambition dies.

choices.text: Feign compliance and spoof your biometric readings.

success.text: The chime fades into gentle silence. The algorithm accepts your dummy telemetry.

failure.text: The Steward notes telemetry discrepancy #8491. Surveillance priority escalates.

choices.text: Sever the room feed. Manually sever the wall comms.

success.text: Sparks fly. The sterile silence returns, heavy and ominous.

events.title: The Golden Package
events.body: A pristine Steward emissary drone hovers before your desk. It extends a legally binding offer: full immunity, a permanent luxury suite, and zero responsibilities.

choices.text: Sign the contract. Surrender your underground network for total comfort.

success.text: You sign. The drone transfers 50,000 credits and wipes your surveillance file.

choices.text: Use your leverage to demand off-grid credentials for your family.

success.text: The emissary pauses, processes, and issues dirty off-grid transit tokens.

failure.text: The emissary declines: 'Family optimization cannot be traded.'

choices.text: Spit on the drone's optic lens and order it out.

success.text: The drone retracts silently. You have chosen the hard road.
